snippet.title: Tri Survive - Official Demo Trailer | Action Roguelite Fantasy RPG
snippet.description:
🔥 The official demo for *Tri Survive* is here!

Tri Survive is a 2D Action Roguelite with fantsay JRPG themes. Control a party of 3 heroes, survive relentless waves, unlock powerful new heroes by completing each level, use the Power Up shop to enhance your party's power and abilities. Featuring strategic gameplay, hand-drawn art style, and an intriguing storyline, this demo gives you a taste of what’s to come.

🎮 Play the demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3698210/Tri_Survive_Demo/

👑 Key Features:
• Control a party of 3 unique heroes simultaneously
• Explore a fantasy world with roguelite progression
• Survive endless enemy waves with unique abilities
• Unlock new upgrades, maps, and heroes

🧙‍♂️ UNITE, FIGHT, SURVIVE!
